knowledge-graph-desc: Waxay ku sawiraysaa garaafka aqoonta ee SemanticMediawiki iyadoo adeegsanaysa VisNetwork.js
apihelp-knowledgegraph-load-nodes-summar: Soo hel sifooyinka semantic-ka ee maqaallada la bixiyey
knowledgegraph-graph-options-message: Riix badhanka hoose oo koobi/ku dheji waxa ku jira furayaasha "nodes" iyo "edges" ee maqaalka sidan. Kadibna u dhig qiimaha xuduudaha "graph-options" ama "property-options?[Property label]" ee shaqada parser-ka ee KnowledgeGraph
knowledgegraph-delete-node-confirm: Ma hubtaa inaad doonayso inaad tirtirto node-kan?
knowledgegraph-dialog-select-categories: Dooro hal ama ka badan oo qaybaha ah
knowledgegraph-dialog-select-properties: Dooro hal ama ka badan oo sifooyinka ah
knowledgegraph-dialog-select-nodes: Dooro hal ama ka badan oo bogagga ah
knowledgegraph-dialog-results-skipped-ex: Node-yada soo socda ayaa hore u jiray waana la dhaafay:
knowledgegraph-dialog-results-no-new-nod: Ma jiraan node-yo cusub oo lagu daro.
knowledgegraph-dialog-results-select-pro: Calaamadee sifo kasta oo aad doonayso in lagu muujiyo garaafka. Dhammaan sifooyinka waa la soo rarayaa si kasta; kuwa aan la calaamadin weli waa la muujin karaa mar dambe.
knowledgegraph-toolbar-reset-network-con: Ma hubtaa inaad doonayso inaad dib u bilowdo garaafka?
